summary: Viking Therapeutics filed a 424B5 pricing a $275.0M primary common stock offering of 7,857,143 shares at $35.00 each, versus a $40.85 last sale on September 22, 2026, a roughly 14% discount; net proceeds before expenses are $258.5M, with a 30-day option for 1,178,571 additional shares. Concurrently, a separate 2.00% convertible senior notes due 2032 offering totals $225.0M plus a $33.75M option, neither closing contingent on the other. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, Jefferies and Leerink; settlement expected September 25, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch follow-on pricing pressure and note overhang.
